user.title: Safe Export
user.description: Choose the five sensors the 6pm prediction reads, and the battery's usable capacity.

data_description.temp_entity: Forecast mean temperature (°C) for 6pm to 11am. Required: the run fails closed without it.
data_description.humidity_entity: Forecast mean relative humidity (%) for 6pm to 11am. Optional at run time: the cooling zone falls back to a temperature-only model.
data_description.solcast_entity: Tomorrow's PV forecast (kWh). Optional at run time: the heating zone falls back to a temperature-only model.
data_description.soc_entity: Current battery state of charge (%). Required.
data_description.min_soc_entity: The battery's minimum discharge floor (%). Required.
data_description.battery_capacity_kwh: Capacity used to convert state of charge into energy.
